Research brief · As of 5 Oct 2026 (ET)

What’s coming for Merlin

Forward items only, from the researched timeline. Dates and briefings below are as published in the cited sources, not completed outcomes. Industry / military context items are labeled as such.

Dates as published Estimated items labeled

Forward calendar

  • 12–14 Oct 2026
    Merlin said

    Management at Maxim Growth Summit, New York

    Merlin management is scheduled to participate. Maxim initiated MRLN at Buy with a $7 target on 18 Sep 2026. The summit ends the day before the estimated ~15 Oct reset date.

    Merlin release 5 Oct 2026

  • ~15 Oct 2026 (est.)
    Merlin said · estimated Filing formula

    Warrant strike and preferred conversion reset window

    The Q2 10-Q describes a reset on the 21st trading day after the date that is six months after closing. Closing was 16 Mar 2026, so the six-month anniversary is 16 Sep 2026; the measurement window falls around mid-October 2026 (about 15 Oct 2026 if counted as the 21st trading day after 16 Sep). If the 20-day VWAP is below the then-current price, the strike / conversion resets to the greater of that VWAP and a $5.00 floor. At recent prices near $1.71, the reset may hit that floor. This date is estimated from the filing’s formula; Merlin has not published a calendar notice of the exact reset day.

    Q2 10-Q warrant note

  • Nov 2026
    Industry / military context

    SOCOM RDT&E planned award months

    FY2027 SOCOM book prints November 2026 award plans: AEA Aviation Mission Autonomy ($3.100M, performer “Various”), ITMS MC-130J software ($3.500M, Lockheed), Aviation Engineering Analysis ($5.898M, “Various”). None of those lines name Merlin. An award month in a justification is a plan.

    RDTE_SOCOM_PB_2027.pdf

    Merlin said

    Management at ROTH Technology Conference, New York

    Merlin release 5 Oct 2026

  • 11 December 2026
    Industry / military context

    FY2027 continuing resolution ends

    The FY2027 continuing resolution (P.L. 119-103, H.R. 6500, signed 2 September 2026) funds federal agencies, including defense, at FY2026 levels until full-year FY2027 appropriations pass or this date, whichever comes first. If neither a new bill nor another stopgap passes, funding lapses 12 December. Under the CR, DoD cannot start projects that lacked FY2026 funding (Sec. 104), so a brand-new funded Merlin program before full-year appropriations is unlikely. Work already funded can continue.

    H.R. 6500 · P.L. 119-103
